responsibility: This file implements the NDS32 RTL optimization pass that repurposes the frame-pointer register as a global/static data base register in size-oriented non-Linux 16-bit code. It analyzes function shape, prologue/epilogue viability, dominance and exit structure, symbol-based memory access counts, and user options to decide whether the transformation is worthwhile, then adjusts IRA hard-register availability and per-function machine state so later prologue generation and addressing can exploit $fp-as-gp.
